learningObjective: Trace one shared state representation into the actor and critic objectives, and identify where the advantage must be treated as a fixed signal during the actor update.
mediumRationale: A deterministic SVG is the smallest medium that can align the shared trunk, two forward branches, two losses, parameter-update paths, and an explicit stop-gradient boundary. Mermaid can show topology but cannot place the detachment boundary and mathematical labels reliably; semantic HTML would make the converging and diverging paths harder to trace; interaction adds no necessary state; paper reuse adds licensing risk without improving this general mechanism; and no visual leaves the article's hardest spatial model unresolved.

pages.insight: The deck contrasts iid supervised samples with dependent RL trajectories and frames both domains as learning mappings from inputs or states to outputs or actions.
The policy-optimization slide shows a state-to-action policy network, sampled actions, discounted rewards, and a REINFORCE-style policy update; it contains no critic or shared actor-critic trunk.

deckReview.notes: Copilot CLI agent 5 inspected PDF pages 154-157 directly: page 154 is the Reinforcement Learning section divider, pages 155-156 provide the relevant ML/RL and policy-gradient context, and page 157 begins Past projects. No slide in this neighboring range presents actor-critic architecture, separate objectives, or a stop-gradient boundary, so no deck figure applies for reuse.

sourceReview.notes: The shipped SVG is an original composition using the article's notation and the site's established visual primitives. It does not reproduce paper-specific geometry or empirical data, and no third-party visual asset is included.

agentReview.summary: Independent review identified the split from shared state features into actor and critic objectives as the hardest prose-only model. The final design makes the fixed advantage signal and separate parameter updates explicit without implying that shared trunk parameters receive only one loss.

implementation.accessibility: The SVG has a programmatic title and full description. Every node and path is directly labeled; solid forward arrows, dashed update arrows, distinct node shapes, and a labeled stop bar preserve the lesson without color. The established visual-scroll wrapper keeps labels at a readable size at 390 CSS pixels, while theme variables and print overrides support dark mode and paper.
